sentences.text: Frank is the debut studio album by English singer and songwriter Amy Winehouse , released on 20 October 2003 by Island Records .	Amy Winehouse	Amy Winehouse	Island	Island Records	Island Records	Island Records

Production for the album took place during 2002 to 2003 and was handled by Winehouse , Salaam Remi , Gordon `` Commissioner Gordon '' Williams , Jimmy Hogarth and Matt Rowe .	Jimmy Hogarth	Jimmy Hogarth	Salaam Remi	Salaam Remi
Its title alludes to the nature and tone of Winehouse 's lyrics on the album , as well as one of her influences , Frank Sinatra .	Frank Sinatra	Frank Sinatra
Upon its release , Frank received generally positive reviews from most music critics and earned Winehouse several accolades , including an Ivor Novello Award .	Ivor Novello Award	Ivor Novello Award

The album has sold over one million copies in the United Kingdom and has been certified triple platinum by the British Phonographic Industry -LRB- BPI -RRB- .	British Phonographic Industry	British Phonographic Industry
